newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CVRD still a Nomura buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CVRD still a Nomura buy.

text.p: -- Nomura Securities said it is maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD).
-- "CVRD's privatization process is running smoothly," the investment bank said. "All the main barriers to the initial stage of privatization have been overcome."
-- Nomura said the outlook for privatization is likely to boost CVRD stock as the February auction of an initial 45 percent stake in the firm approaches.
-- The Japanese bank cited the publication of CVRD's privatization rules on Friday, which outlined the terms of the firm's sale in three blocks.

-- "The government has placed restrictions on several types of investors, including large foreign iron ore producers, large steel firms, iron ore traders and short-term investors," Nomura said. A base price and other details are due in December. The government also will be issuing itself golden shares in both CVRD and the special holding company to be set up by the winning bidder, giving it veto power over any sale of the shares for the first five years, it said.
